responsibility: Generates the Rust frontend’s compiled Unicode property tables from upstream Unicode data files. This script parses UnicodeData.txt, DerivedNormalizationProps.txt, and DerivedCoreProperties.txt, extracts canonical decomposition mappings, recomposition inputs, combining classes, Alphabetic ranges, numeric code points, and NFC quick-check ranges, and emits the C++ definitions placed in rust-unicode-data.h that are later consumed by normalization and character-classification code.
